@login_required def view_cart(request): cart_items = CartItem.objects.filter(user=request.user) total_price = sum(item.product.price_per_kg * item.quantity for item in cart_items) if request.method == "POST" and request.POST.get('confirm') == 'cod': for item in cart_items: Order.objects.create( vendor=item.product.supplier, # Supplier is vendor here items=None, # Not using m2m for now created_at=timezone.now(), remarks="COD Order", status='In Process' ) # Reduce stock to 0 after ordering item.product.quantity = 0 item.product.save() item.delete() messages.success(request, "Order placed successfully via Cash on Delivery!") return redirect('my_orders') return render(request, 'vendors/view_cart.html', { 'cart_items': cart_items, 'total_price': total_price })
